verdict.rationale: The core SDK runs language, speech, and vision models entirely on the user's own device with no network. The same CLI runs local models offline and without an account. Hosted vs. local execution is an explicit user choice, so the product can be run wholly on user-controlled hardware. missing for 10: no way to self-host the Wally Cloud OpenAI-compatible endpoint or its large models, the MetalRT engine is a commercial component rather than open source, and hands-on reports of local installs segfaulting or failing to load undercut confidence in the self-run path.
